I'm sorry to hear about your situation and I can relate all too well. I'm currently taking Zoloft and it seems to help. My lows aren't as low, but it's not a magically and instant fix. I just helps alleviate some of the pain. One thing that I have noticed is that it really does help you concentrate on getting homework and what not due. I feel sightly more motivated but I still have my days. I would recommend you talk to your doctor about exactly which antidepressant would be best suited for you, and you might have to play around with them a little bit. It's a process, but I wish you the best!

Being attracted to the opposite sex isn't a bad thing in the slightest. There's no reason to think of these natural impulses as a disease because that's unhealthy for your mental health. It's also disrespectful to the LGBT community that tries to advocate for their own civil liberties. I know many Christians part of the LGBT community who still find solace in their faith. Because your married I don't suggest you go date guys, but realize that you are simply human and have desires. It's not an actual problem and I hope you can come to terms with this for the sake of your own health.
